mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terminal_recording (recording_id, connection_id, session_id, cols, `rows`, status, started_at) VALUES (#{recordingId}, #{connectionId}, #{sessionId}, #{cols}, #{rows}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, recording_id, connection_id, session_id, cols, `rows`, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms FROM terminal_recording WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50
